result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** as the best overall project management tool, particularly for tech startups and product-led teams.

However, the best choice depends on your team's size, working style, budget, and whether you're managing software development, business operations, marketing, or all of them.

Here's how I'd compare the leading options.

## Best project management tools compared

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Fast, clean interface.
- Great for engineering teams.
- Less suited to general business operations.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Dashboards: Build custom reports you can actually work from | ClickUp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7--5qp5synzBaglxadXwGdIMCdbaFt3KwHkKkJNg7RTc6Z-9h2jNcaPsgUnIeOvSAtk2HXXQMHEBIBv-U9Fq_KtVc32EO3p3lauJCgLThaNnM9-8vOw8JT7GgiopMybXXtzEPqWsAp0RcubN3Zv3GdSnK__3TuPQiH178_-nNgdQ1MBi18wfvuk2Ju77wZ18?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one option)

- Tasks, docs, goals and dashboards.
- Good for multiple departments.
- Extensive customisation.
- Can feel overwhelming initially.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Asana**

- Great for cross-functional teams.
- Clear ownership and deadlines.
- Excellent project visibility.
- Some useful features require paid plans.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Getting started with projects and tasks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rBzz0YucWqa7TzwsR7O0OijwcWtKRR6vUa-4dyys2qUThLtS4XfkdJkNbKUF7MlYIx2Pf95vz1ZwpmkGZkQkQJbR9XXSMKgQ3ynqVH_YRdhbdeiYO_anFWUt5rh2LV_lCuu0TZ7Njj7N3y1Z8_one9wjd1Cn5GmMKHW8zKADzpdtXUtH6f9EQMV9lVkrxAxK?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Notion**

- Combines documentation, wikis and tasks.
- Great for startup knowledge management.
- Flexible templates.
- Less specialised for complex project tracking.

[Visit Notion](https://notion.so/)

---

![Portfolio management - All Projects Dashboard – Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-5NH-hROEcQXpSQPmMUJv0x7GODAoqXeNRlBaAmeb5yjL6ws1fsUSsHXZKs7cGHwGwKjC6qsKZvaA0-fO7oD8-9_bc-PbX0_EJ1QpOPifoMbrdCVNNuollQzaJIhYGySdgXpxRYlPlDaiOA8sl0RXCUZIj48mjl4S_hb7oB4Rygmeul72nI4kZxZvS769XKO?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Excellent visual dashboards.
- Useful for marketing, sales and operations.
- Good automation capabilities.
- Can become expensive as the team grows.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

[www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/project-management-software-for-startups/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[waveup.com](https://waveup.com/blog/7-best-project-management-software-for-startups-in2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[hackceleration.com](https://hackceleration.com/labs/best/startup-project-management-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Pre-seed, 2–5 people | Notion or Trello |
| Seed-stage, 5–15 people | ClickUp |
| Tech startup building software | Linear |
| Growing team, 15–50 people | Asana |
| Multiple departments and workflows | ClickUp or Monday |


## What I'd actually implement

For a typical early-stage startup, I'd start with\:

- **Project management\:** ClickUp
- **Documentation\:** Notion
- **Communication\:** Slack
- **Product development\:** Linear (if building software)

Avoid introducing too many tools at the beginning. Your team needs one clear source of truth for tasks, priorities and ownership.

## Let me narrow it down to the best choice

There are three things that would help me make a much more precise recommendation.

**1\. How big is your startup team?**

---

**4\. What's your monthly budget per person?**
